title: Filter with a captured threshold
prompt: Return a new vector of values strictly greater than threshold in input order. Do not change the source. Use std::copy_if with a lambda that captures the threshold by value.

tests.label: Negative threshold
tests.hint: Compare with the supplied value, not zero.

hints: [threshold] copies that local value into the lambda.
back_inserter appends accepted values to result.
explanation: A lambda is a small callable written beside its use. Value capture makes the threshold available during each predicate call without modifying or borrowing the caller’s vector.
